sentences.text:
Author: R. Raghunandan Rao
Bench: R. Raghunandan Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice R. Raghunandan Rao
 Criminal Petition No.9284 of 2022
Order:

A Crime in F.I.R No.188 of 2021, dated 05.06.2021 has been registered in Martur Police Station,
Prakasam District, against the petitioner under Section 20 (2) of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production,
Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 on the ground that the petitioner was caught storing tobacco and tobacco products.

entities.text:
Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production,
Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. The cases are being booked against persons, who are found to be either storing or transporting tobacco or tobacco products in the State of Andhra Pradesh.

Persons, who are facing such cases,
have been approaching this Court for relief.

3. In Crl.P.No.5421 of 2019 and batch dated 18.12.2019, a learned Single Judge of this Court had held that tobacco does not fall within the definitions of "food" and as such, registration of Crime under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 is not permissible.

4. In W.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018, a learned Single Judge of this Court had held the police would not have jurisdiction to initiate or investigate any offences punishable under the provision of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
A learned Single Judge had also held that transport or storage of tobacco and tobacco products would not constitute an offence punishable under Sections 270 to 273 of Indian Penal Code.

5. In view of the aforesaid findings which are being consistently followed by this Court, this Criminal Petition is allowed quashing the F.I.R No.188 of 2021, dated 05.06.2021 has been registered in Martur Police Station, Prakasam District, against the petitioner.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
R. RAGHUNANDAN RAO, J 23.11.2022 BSM HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE R. RAGHUNANDAN RAO
CRIMINAL PETITION No.9284 of 2022 23.11.2022 BSM Sriram Shiva Shankar vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 23 November, 2022
